The test image shows corn plants viewed from below at a low angle, looking up at the stalks and leaf sheaths. I can see orange-yellow to brownish discoloration on the leaf sheaths/stem area. This could be stem/leaf-sheath related disease. Top candidates: Purple_Leaf_Sheath, Common_Rust, Southern_Rust, Physoderma_Brown_Spot.

Let me view reference images one at a time, one per class first.
Purple_Leaf_Sheath shows dark brown/purple lesions on leaf sheaths. The test image has a more orange-yellow discoloration spread across multiple plants. Let me check Common_Rust.
Common_Rust shows discrete pustules on leaves. Let me check Southern_Rust next.
Southern_Rust shows dense orange pustules on leaves. Let me check Physoderma_Brown_Spot.
Physoderma_Brown_Spot shows banded small yellow/orange spots with dark midrib lesions. Let me check Gray_Leaf_Spot and Goss_S_Wilt.
Gray_Leaf_Spot shows gray rectangular lesions. Let me look at another Southern_Rust image since it can also affect leaf sheaths.

This Southern_Rust reference shows dense orange pustules covering both leaf surface and leaf sheath/midrib. This matches the orange coloration in the test image well. Let me check Common_Rust for comparison.
I've seen 5 classes so far. I need one more new class. Let me check Goss_S_Wilt.

Goss's Wilt shows tan/gray water-soaked streaks, not matching the test image.

**Summary of analysis:**

The test image shows corn plants from a low angle with prominent **light orange/cinnamon-colored** discoloration on the leaf sheaths and scattered orange spots on the leaves.

- **Purple_Leaf_Sheath**: Dark purple-brown-black lesions — color doesn't match the orange coloration in test image
- **Common_Rust**: Dark reddish-brown oval pustules — too dark compared to the lighter orange in test image
- **Southern_Rust** (Corn_Disease_60): Dense light orange/cinnamon pustules covering both leaf surface AND leaf sheath/midrib — this matches the test image very well in both color and distribution pattern
- **Physoderma_Brown_Spot**: Banded yellow spots with dark midrib lesions — no characteristic banding visible in test image
- **Gray_Leaf_Spot**: Rectangular gray/tan lesions — not matching
- **Goss_S_Wilt**: Gray-tan water-soaked streaks — not matching

The test image best matches **Southern_Rust**: the light orange/cinnamon color (vs. darker reddish-brown of Common_Rust), the dense pustule coverage, and the fact that Southern_Rust can extend to leaf sheaths.
